# Runtime ownership and distribution record

On 2026-10-14, the project owner confirmed in the release preparation chat:

> I created and own it

The owner subsequently authorized the public GitHub distribution route:

> yes let's go with MIT for the runtime too and get the GitHub repo ready so I can showcase it in interviews

This records the owner's statement and distribution choice. It does not supply
an upstream repository URL, Git revision, or independently verified authorship.
Those source fields remain absent in `SOURCE_MANIFEST.json`. The reviewed
snapshot files and their content digest remain unchanged.

The runtime is licensed under the accompanying MIT `LICENSE`, replacing the
earlier proprietary distribution choice. Source and compiled copies may be
included in the public repository and Modelcraft installers under that license.
External packages, model weights and native tools retain their supplied licenses.
